title: The Ordinance on Damage to Property of Wrenfield (invented)
about: An invented ordinance of an invented town, written for the example. Its section 1(2) leaves open whether intention may be inferred from what a person did beforehand; nothing in it is any jurisdiction's law.

instruments.title: Ordinance on Damage to Property 2015 (Town of Wrenfield)

provisions.label: Section 1(1)
provisions.text: A person who sets fire to property belonging to another, intending to damage it, commits damage by fire.

provisions.label: Section 1(2)
provisions.text: A person is not to be taken to have intended damage merely because damage followed; intention may be found from all the evidence, including what the person did beforehand.

rules.quote: sets fire to property belonging to another, intending to damage it
